work.summary: I am an Assistant Professor in the Department of Chemistry at BITS Pilani. My research interests include understanding and designing nanoparticle based complex systems for next generation of sensing and catalysis. I also use AI and automation to accelerate science.
highlights: Self-Assembly, Nanoparticle Catalysis, Sensing, Non-equilibrium Systems, AI for Science, Plasmonics
